title: Review: Azure/GCS backend commit
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — probe delete silently swallowed means GC permission not verified at startup; GCS dual-credential is a silent footgun; allow_http in production is unguarded. The probe duplication across 6 modules is the highest maintenance debt item.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) not having run against a live Azure or GCS endpoint — the object_store builder behavior when both service_account_path and service_account_key are set is read from source code analysis, not empirical verification; (2) the put_block CID mismatch issue depends on whether any caller in the reader POST path can reach put_block with attacker-controlled CID — I traced the call graph but did not read every upstream caller. Would raise confidence if: read the full reader POST path from NNTP command handler to put_block call to confirm CID provenance; run the Azurite emulator integration test against the startup probe.
